title: YouCoded name and icons — round 8: clean lettering, the mascot lifted off the glass

steps.path: Website header (beside the icon), marketing, help pages
steps.headline: Which ways of writing "youcoded" do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: Pure lettering this time — four rounds of mascot-inside-the-word didn't work, so the icon carries the mascot and sits beside the name in every header shown.

variants.label: T1 Site lettering, "you" in mascot colour
variants.summary: DM Sans, tight lowercase, "you" in the purple-to-pink glass colour.

variants.label: T2 Rounded, all in mascot colour
variants.summary: Nunito Black with the whole word in the gradient and a faint glass sheen.

variants.label: T4 Soft rounded
variants.summary: M PLUS Rounded: soft round stroke ends, like the mascot's limbs.

variants.label: T5 Tight and confident
variants.summary: Plus Jakarta Sans, all one colour; the icon carries the personality.

variants.label: T6 Glass letters
variants.summary: The word in the site's frosted glass, for heroes; plain in headers and help pages.

steps.headline: Which app icons do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: Variants of your G2, G6 and G5 picks, with the mascot lifted clearly off the background. True sizes, today's icon beside it, and three other themes.

variants.label: K1 Milk-glass mascot (G2)
variants.summary: Near-opaque glass silhouette with eyes, bright rim and shadow.

variants.label: K2 Layered glass (G2)
variants.summary: Colour-glass mascot on a frosted pane; muddy below 32px.

variants.label: K3 Night (G2)
variants.summary: Wallpaper dimmed to night, the milk-glass mascot glowing in front.

variants.label: K4 Just the face, milk-glass (G6)
variants.summary: Body-shaped milk-glass panel and two eyes.

variants.label: K5 Just the face, colour-glass (G6)
variants.summary: Purple glass face on the site's frosted white tile.

variants.label: K6 Stands up, with a face (G5)
variants.summary: The tile is the body on glass legs; eyes instead of "yc".

variants.label: K7 Stands up, milk-glass "yc" (G5)
variants.summary: White glass body, "yc" in the gradient, colour-glass legs.

variants.label: K8 Standing mascot on a tile (G5)
variants.summary: The standing tile-body on a frosted square, for square-only places.

steps.headline: Which installer icons do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: All in your H3's family: theme colour, a frosted glass band, the arrow, the mascot.

variants.label: J1 Standing on the band
variants.summary: H3 refined, the mascot in rimmed colour-glass.

variants.label: J2 Sinking into the glass
variants.summary: Halfway down through the band, lower half softened by the glass.

variants.label: J3 Peeking up from behind
variants.summary: Only the top of the body and the eyes clear the band.

variants.label: J4 The band is the arrow
variants.summary: A frosted glass chevron, the mascot riding on top.

variants.label: J5 Hanging from the glass
variants.summary: The band at the top, the mascot hanging from it, about to drop in.
